🚗 You went through driving school and drive well: cars, vans and city traffic.

🌱 You hold an ordinary license for cars and small vans and drive with control in traffic, in rain and on narrow streets.
⚠️ High-speed pursuit, evasive driving and heavy trucks are beyond you.
⚖️ No motorcycle, large-vehicle or emergency-vehicle license unless your background says so, and no exemption from traffic law in a chase.
🏫 It shows in easy confidence behind the wheel and eyes that check the mirrors.

📈 Grants: Driving +15
